info.title: TrendRadar Device Authentication API
info.description: Additive device pairing contract. Business reads remain defined by the frozen API V1 contract. Pairing is LAN HTTPS only and is not available through Cloudflare Relay.

post.summary: Redeem an operator-issued one-time pairing code
post.description: HTTPS only. Not exposed by the Relay. Pairing code must be in the Authorization header and is single-use.

200.description: Device credential issued once; store only in Keychain.

400.description: HTTPS required, device label mismatch, or invalid request.

401.description: Pairing code invalid, expired, or already redeemed.

pairingCode.description: Operator-issued one-time code; 10-minute lifetime and one successful redemption.
